blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lead prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro on Tuesday objected to the defense’s repeated use of the word “persecution” during the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, saying it was unfair to those helping the prosecution team. Defense lead impeachment counsel Sheila Sison first mentioned “persecution” while discussing the new trial schedule, which is set to resume on November 9. “This court had given [the] schedule of the resumption of hearings starting from November 9, 10, 11 onwards.
